highlights: Child Protection Policy aligned with Thai Child Protection Act and CRC
Staff Code of Conduct for safeguarding children
safety.policy_summary: NIVA American International School upholds a strict Child Protection Policy supporting the Child Protection Act of Thailand and the Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC). The policy includes comprehensive codes of conduct for all personnel to ensure prevention, protection, and partnership in maintaining a safe learning environment.
